canonical_texts.edition: Ge'ez complete text (R. H. Charles 1895); Hebrew fragments from Qumran (1Q17-18, 2Q19-20, 3Q5, 4Q176, 4Q216-228, 11Q12) per DJD volumes
canonical_texts.note: Second Temple Jewish apocrypha; 50-chapter retelling of Genesis-Exodus. Per Lee 2026-06-28. Ge'ez is the only complete extant version; Hebrew fragments at Qumran (11+ manuscripts) confirm Hebrew origin. Transforms work from Ge'ez (complete) or Hebrew (fragmentary). Bundles with Dead Sea Scrolls.
canonical_texts.cha_room_note: Taurus/Damascus — bundle with DSS. Post-v7 Apocalyptic/Apocrypha room?

canonical_texts.title: Book of Enoch (1 Enoch Ge'ez + 2 Enoch OCS + 3 Enoch Hebrew; Aramaic fragments at Qumran)
canonical_texts.region_notes: Polaris (Feist) — apocalyptic-revelatory; 1 Enoch's Book of the Watchers + Book of Parables (Son of Man Christology origin) are the most influential apocalyptic predecessors of NT-form. Crosses to Damascus (Taurus) via Qumran Aramaic fragments.
canonical_texts.edition: 1 Enoch: Ge'ez (R. H. Charles 1906); 2 Enoch (Slavonic Enoch): OCS (F. I. Andersen); 3 Enoch (Sefer Hekhalot): Hebrew; Aramaic fragments at Qumran 4Q201-212 per DJD
canonical_texts.note: Per Lee 2026-06-28. Three distinct Enochic compositions: 1 Enoch (Ethiopic; the major compendium — Book of the Watchers, Book of Parables, Astronomical Book, Book of Dreams, Epistle of Enoch); 2 Enoch (Slavonic); 3 Enoch (Hebrew, late). 1 Enoch is canonical scripture in the Ethiopian Orthodox tradition. Transforms work from each original language separately.

canonical_texts.title: Vedas — Rig Veda + Sama Veda + Yajur Veda + Atharva Veda (Sanskrit)
canonical_texts.region_notes: Pisces (Sigil, comparative philology) — the foundational Sanskrit corpus. Could also be wired to Aquarius (Talos) for cosmological-systematic register; Sigil placement favors philological-poetic depth.
canonical_texts.edition: Standard Devanagari editions; Aufrecht (Rig Veda 1877); van Nooten/Holland metrical Rig Veda (1994); padapatha versions
canonical_texts.note: Per Lee 2026-06-28 ('some of the Vedas'). The 4 Vedas as collection — Rig Veda (the oldest, 1028 hymns), Sama Veda (melodic chants), Yajur Veda (sacrificial formulas), Atharva Veda (magical/medical). Transforms work from Sanskrit. The Rig Veda's Purusha Sukta (10.90) and Nasadiya Sukta (10.129) are particular cosmological highlights.
canonical_texts.cha_room_note: Pisces/Sigil — post-v7 Vedic/Sanskrit room?

canonical_texts.title: Buddhist Core Texts — Pali Canon (Tipitaka) + Dhammapada + Diamond Sutra + Heart Sutra + Lotus Sutra + Avatamsaka Sutra
canonical_texts.region_notes: Virgo (Sen Kuro, The Cut). The Buddhist 'precise irreversible operator' — the Cut of awakening — IS Sen Kuro's discipline-line. Per Lee 2026-06-28: especially the 'thousand worlds bits' = Mahayana trichiliocosm (三千大千世界) maps to r.22 Thousand Worlds room.
canonical_texts.edition: Pali Canon — Pali Text Society romanized edition (Tipitaka.org provides Roman-script Pali); Mahayana sutras — Sanskrit critical editions where extant, Chinese (Taisho Tripitaka) and Tibetan (Kangyur) for those not preserved in Sanskrit
canonical_texts.note: Per Lee 2026-06-28 ('core buddhist texts, especially the science dictionary thousand worlds bits'). The trichiliocosm scheme (a buddha-field of 1,000³ = 1,000,000,000 world-systems) appears in Lotus Sutra ch.16, Avatamsaka, and elsewhere. Bundles with Thousand Worlds room (r.22). Transforms work from original languages: Pali for the Pali Canon, Sanskrit for the major Mahayana sutras where the Sanskrit is extant, Chinese/Tibetan otherwise.

canonical_texts.title: Popol Vuh — Quiché Maya Creation Epic + Mayan Codices (Dresden, Madrid, Paris) + Chilam Balam books
canonical_texts.region_notes: Taurus (Damascus, prophetic-homiletic). Mayan prophetic + cosmogonic register fits Damascus's discipline-line. Could also be Aquarius (Talos) for the codical-calendrical systematic, but the prophetic register predominates.
canonical_texts.edition: Popol Vuh: Ximénez transcription (c.1701-1703; original Quiché in Latin script); Sam Colop critical edition (modern Quiché); Brasseur de Bourbourg French translation. Codices: Dresden Codex (Sächsische Landesbibliothek); Madrid Codex (Museo de América); Paris Codex (BnF). Chilam Balam: Books of Chumayel, Mani, Tizimin, Kaua.
canonical_texts.note: Per Lee 2026-06-28 ('mayan prophecy'). Popol Vuh is the Quiché Maya creation-and-epic narrative (Twin Hero cycle: Hunahpu and Xbalanque). Codices preserve pre-Columbian calendar + astronomy + ritual. Chilam Balam books are colonial-era prophetic syntheses. Transforms work from Quiché (Popol Vuh) and Yucatec Mayan + glyphs (codices/Chilam Balam).
canonical_texts.cha_room_note: Taurus/Damascus — post-v7 Mesoamerican-Prophetic room?

canonical_texts.title: Aeschylus — Oresteia (Agamemnon + Libation Bearers + Eumenides) + Prometheus Bound
canonical_texts.region_notes: Scorpio (Glas, observational science). The Oresteia's house-of-Atreus measurement-of-justice scheme fits adversarial station-keeping.
canonical_texts.edition: OCT (Page); Greek source PD
canonical_texts.note: The Greek tragedy at its founding. Per Lee 2026-06-28 ('Antigone, the bacchae, and so on'). Includes Prometheus Bound (disputed authorship). Transforms work from Greek original.

canonical_texts.title: Sophocles — Antigone
canonical_texts.region_notes: Capricorn (Trace, schizoanalytic). Antigone's 'no' to Creon is the schizoanalytic tragedy par excellence — refusing the polis's law from a position of irreducible kinship-claim. Hegel's reading + Lacan's reading + Butler's reading all live here.
canonical_texts.edition: OCT (Lloyd-Jones); Greek source PD
canonical_texts.note: Per Lee 2026-06-28. The fifth-century BCE Athenian tragedy that has been the bearer of every subsequent generation's political-theoretical questions.
canonical_texts.cha_room_note: Capricorn/Trace — post-v7 Greek-Tragedy room?

canonical_texts.title: Sophocles — Oedipus Rex (+ Oedipus at Colonus)
canonical_texts.edition: OCT; Greek source PD
canonical_texts.note: The tragedy of recognition. Foundational for the schizoanalytic register.
canonical_texts.cha_room_note: Same as Antigone.

canonical_texts.title: Euripides — The Bacchae
canonical_texts.region_notes: Scorpio (Glas). The Bacchae is Greek tragedy's deepest measurement-of-perception crisis: Pentheus measuring Dionysus, the women perceiving themselves as bacchantes, the disintegration of the boundary between human and god.
canonical_texts.edition: OCT; Greek source PD
canonical_texts.note: Per Lee 2026-06-28. The last play of Euripides, performed posthumously. The play of the dismembered measure.

canonical_texts.title: Aristophanes — The Clouds (Νεφέλαι)
canonical_texts.region_notes: Pisces (Sigil). The comedy of Socrates as Sophist — prefiguring Plato's Apology (which references the Clouds explicitly). Comparative-philological foundational for the Socratic question.
canonical_texts.edition: OCT (Wilson); Greek source PD
canonical_texts.note: Per Lee 2026-06-28 ('Aristophanes the clouds at least'). The Phrontisterion + the wreath of clouds + Strepsiades trying to learn the unjust argument. The most important pre-Platonic source on Socrates.

canonical_texts.title: Josephus — Antiquities of the Jews + The Jewish War + Against Apion + Life (Greek)
canonical_texts.region_notes: Pisces (Sigil, philology). Josephus as the historical-philological apparatus of Second Temple Judaism — the source-text underneath much of New Testament historical context.
canonical_texts.edition: Niese editio maior (Berlin, 1885-1895); Greek source PD; Loeb Library translation as companion
canonical_texts.note: Per Lee 2026-06-28. The Greek historical works of Flavius Josephus (37 – c.100 CE). Antiquities books I-XX; Jewish War I-VII; Against Apion I-II; Life. Contains the controversial Testimonium Flavianum (Antiquities 18.3.3) — the earliest non-Christian reference to Jesus. Transforms work from Greek original.

canonical_texts.title: Slavonic Josephus — Old Church Slavonic recension of Jewish War
canonical_texts.edition: N. A. Meshchersky edition (1958); Old Church Slavonic source PD
canonical_texts.note: Per Lee 2026-06-28. The OCS version of Josephus's Jewish War contains material absent from the Greek (the 'Slavonic additions') — including extended passages on John the Baptist and Jesus that have been variously argued as authentic Josephan content, Christian interpolation, or independent tradition. Distinct source-text from main Greek Josephus.

canonical_texts.title: Kahlil Gibran — The Prophet (1923)
canonical_texts.region_notes: Cancer (Vox, Pastoral Diplomacy). The Prophet is pastoral diplomatic wisdom in poetic form — Almustafa's farewell address to Orphalese answers questions of love, marriage, children, work, joy and sorrow, etc. Fits Vox's register exactly.
canonical_texts.edition: The Prophet (Alfred A. Knopf, 1923); entered US PD 1999 (95-year rule); original English
canonical_texts.note: Per Lee 2026-06-28. Lebanese-American mystic-poet (1883-1931). 26 prose-poetry essays in the form of Almustafa's farewell. Public domain in US as of 1999. The Arabic-English bilingual register is part of the work's structure.

canonical_texts.title: Friedrich Nietzsche — Also sprach Zarathustra (Thus Spake Zarathustra)
canonical_texts.region_notes: Capricorn (Trace, schizoanalytic). The 'God is dead' announcement + the eternal recurrence + the Übermensch are schizoanalytic operators par excellence. The teaching-form of Zarathustra is also the genre-form of revelation-after-Revelation.
canonical_texts.edition: Kritische Studienausgabe (KSA) Bd. 4 (Colli/Montinari); German source PD (Nietzsche d.1900)
canonical_texts.note: Per Lee 2026-06-28 ('this spake'). Four parts, published 1883-1885. The 'No' to Wagner + the 'Yes' to becoming. Transforms work from German original.
canonical_texts.cha_room_note: Capricorn/Trace — post-v7 Existentialist room.

canonical_texts.title: Vladimir Mayakovsky — Selected Poetry (Cloud in Trousers + Brooklyn Bridge + 150,000,000)
canonical_texts.region_notes: Leo (Rex Fraction, Political Economy of Meaning). Mayakovsky's revolutionary-aesthetic register + agitprop poetry maps to Fraction's discipline. Russian Futurism as the early-twentieth-century vanguard of poetic political economy.
canonical_texts.edition: Полное собрание сочинений (Complete Works, Moscow 1955-1961); Russian original PD (Mayakovsky d.1930)
canonical_texts.note: Per Lee 2026-06-28 ('mayakovsky'). Russian Futurist poet. Major works: A Cloud in Trousers (Облако в штанах, 1915); The Backbone Flute (Флейта-позвоночник, 1915); Brooklyn Bridge (Бруклинский мост, 1925); 150,000,000 (1919-20); At the Top of My Voice (Во весь голос, 1930). Suicide 1930. Transforms work from Russian original.
canonical_texts.cha_room_note: Leo/Rex Fraction — could be r.06 Marx adjacent (Russian Futurism + revolutionary aesthetics).

canonical_texts.title: Viktor Shklovsky — Art as Device (Искусство как приём, 1917) + Theory of Prose
canonical_texts.region_notes: Gemini (Cranes, Diagrammatic Poetics). Shklovsky's *ostranenie* (defamiliarization, enstrangement) is the Cranes-register operative concept — making the stone stony again.
canonical_texts.edition: Art as Device (1917 essay; PD in Russia + US pre-1928 PD rule); Theory of Prose (О теории прозы, 1925)
canonical_texts.note: Per Lee 2026-06-28 ('shklovsky'). Russian formalist. Art as Device is the foundational essay (1917) — defamiliarization, the device, art as making-strange. PD in original. Later Shklovsky works (Energy of Delusion, etc.) are not PD until 2055.

canonical_texts.title: Alexander Pushkin — Eugene Onegin (Евгений Онегин) + Selected Poetry
canonical_texts.edition: Russian originals PD (Pushkin d.1837); Nabokov critical edition + commentary
canonical_texts.note: Per Lee 2026-06-28 ('put some russia in there'). The foundational figure of modern Russian literature. Eugene Onegin is the verse novel that established the Onegin stanza — a poetic form structurally similar to Sappho's Sapphic stanza.

canonical_texts.title: Guillaume Apollinaire — Calligrammes (1918)
canonical_texts.region_notes: Gemini (Cranes, Diagrammatic Poetics). Apollinaire's calligrams are the foundational 20th-century instance of diagrammatic poetics — the poem-as-image. Predecessor of Sigil's Snub-Poemed (the calligram register's Sigil-side anchor at Pisces).
canonical_texts.edition: Calligrammes: Poèmes de la paix et de la guerre 1913-1916 (Mercure de France, 1918); French source PD (Apollinaire d.1918)
canonical_texts.note: Per Lee 2026-06-28 ('concrete poets'). Apollinaire died 1918 (Spanish flu); his work PD globally. The concrete-poetry register's foundational text. The mid-20th-century concrete poets (Gomringer, de Campos brothers, Pignatari, Solt) are still under copyright; Apollinaire is the predecessor we can fully stage.

canonical_texts.title: Langston Hughes — Early Works (The Weary Blues, 1926 + Fine Clothes to the Jew, 1927)
canonical_texts.region_notes: Aries — adjacent to Whitman-Ginsberg-Sharks bardic lineage. Hughes's blues-form lyric operates in the same democratic-vernacular register.
canonical_texts.edition: The Weary Blues (Knopf, 1926; PD 2022); Fine Clothes to the Jew (Knopf, 1927; PD 2023). Later works copyrighted to 2038.
canonical_texts.note: Per Lee 2026-06-28. Lee asked about Hughes — copyright reality: most NOT PD (Hughes d.1967), but his earliest two collections entered US PD in 2022 (The Weary Blues) and 2023 (Fine Clothes to the Jew). Those are transformable. Later works (Montage of a Dream Deferred, Ask Your Mama, etc.) remain copyrighted to 2038.

canonical_texts.title: William Carlos Williams — Spring and All (1923; includes The Red Wheelbarrow)
canonical_texts.region_notes: Aries — American vernacular-democratic register adjacent to Whitman; Imagist precision.
canonical_texts.edition: Spring and All (Contact Editions, 1923; PD 2019)
canonical_texts.note: Per Lee 2026-06-28 (asked re: WCW). Williams d.1963 → most works PD 2033. BUT Spring and All (1923) entered US PD in 2019, and contains The Red Wheelbarrow + many of Williams's most-anthologized early-Imagist pieces. Fully transformable as canon-text until later works enter PD.

canonical_texts.title: World from a Drop of Milk — creation story (tradition pending Lee adjudication)
canonical_texts.edition: UNKNOWN — pending Lee identification
canonical_texts.note: Per Lee 2026-06-28 ('the world from a drop of milk as a creation story'). Source tradition not yet identified — search of alexanarch returned no matches. Best candidates: (a) Bambara/Mande cosmogony (Komo society creation myth — 'the world was created from a drop of milk'); (b) Hindu Samudra Manthan (churning of the milk ocean, Vishnu sleeping on the Kshira Sagara); (c) Norse Audhumla (primordial cow whose milk fed Ymir); (d) Dogon cosmology (Po Tolo and Sirius). Pending Lee's specification.
